label: BIRP
description: Behavior / Intervention / Response / Plan — standard for group therapy, residential treatment, and substance-use disorder programs. Emphasizes the therapeutic process over diagnosis.

fields.label: Presenting Behavior
fields.ai_hint: What the client did and said during the session.

fields.label: Mood/Affect
fields.ai_hint: Client's self-reported mood and observed affective tone.

fields.label: Reported Symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Discrete symptoms the client reported in this session.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic techniques the clinician applied during the session.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.ai_hint: Why these interventions were chosen for this client at this time.

fields.label: Client Response
fields.ai_hint: How the client responded to the interventions used.

fields.label: Engagement Level
fields.ai_hint: Observed engagement during the session (resistant, ambivalent, engaged, etc.).

fields.label: Progress Observed
fields.ai_hint: Within-session shifts the clinician noted in the client's presentation.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks or practices assigned to the client between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned clinical focus for upcoming sessions.

fields.label: Next Session
fields.ai_hint: Scheduled date/time or cadence for the next appointment.

label: DAP
description: Data / Assessment / Plan — the most common SOAP alternative for individual therapy. Collapses the Subjective/Objective split into a single Data section.

fields.label: Presenting Concern
fields.ai_hint: The primary issue the client raised in this session.

fields.label: Mood/Affect
fields.ai_hint: Client's self-reported mood and observed affective tone.

fields.label: Symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Discrete symptoms the client reported in this session.

fields.label: Session Content
fields.ai_hint: A concise narrative of what the client discussed in session.

fields.label: Observations
fields.ai_hint: Clinician-observed presentation, behavior, and speech.

fields.label: Clinical Impression
fields.ai_hint: Clinician's overall impression of the client's current state.

fields.label: Progress
fields.ai_hint: Movement relative to treatment goals since the last session.

fields.label: Risk Assessment
fields.ai_hint: Any observed or reported risk to self or others.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic interventions applied during this session.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks or practices assigned to the client between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned clinical focus for upcoming sessions.

fields.label: Next Session
fields.ai_hint: Scheduled date/time or cadence for the next appointment.

label: GIRP
description: Goal / Intervention / Response / Plan — outcome-driven format common where insurers require goal and outcome tracking aligned to a treatment plan.

fields.label: Session Goal
fields.ai_hint: The specific goal or focus area being worked on this session.

fields.label: Treatment Plan Objective
fields.ai_hint: The overarching objective from the treatment plan this session targets.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic techniques the clinician applied this session.

fields.label: Rationale
fields.ai_hint: Why these interventions match the stated goal.

fields.label: Client Response
fields.ai_hint: How the client responded to the interventions used.

fields.label: Progress Toward Goal
fields.ai_hint: Observed movement toward the session goal.

fields.label: Measurable Outcome
fields.ai_hint: Observable change during or after the session.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks aligned to the session goal, assigned between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned focus for the next session.

fields.label: Goal Status
fields.ai_hint: Status of the session goal: achieved, partial, no progress, or modified.

label: Intake
description: First-session biopsychosocial assessment, billed as CPT 90791. Patient-context document supporting medical necessity for the course of treatment. Required by CMS MBPM Ch. 15 §160, Joint Commission EC/PC standards, and CARF 1.H. before ongoing therapy is reimbursable.

fields.label: Referral Reason
fields.ai_hint: Why the patient was referred or sought care, in their own words where possible. Usually surfaces in the opening minutes of the session.

fields.label: Chief Complaint
fields.ai_hint: The primary problem that brought the patient in today. Use the patient's own words in quotes when they're clear.

fields.label: History of Present Illness
fields.ai_hint: Onset, duration, severity, triggers, course, and prior episodes of the chief complaint as the patient describes them.

fields.label: Psychiatric History
fields.ai_hint: Prior mental-health diagnoses, treatments, hospitalizations, and medications as the patient reports them. Leave empty if not discussed.

fields.label: Medical History
fields.ai_hint: Relevant medical conditions, surgeries, and chronic illnesses the patient mentions. Leave empty if not discussed.

fields.label: Current Medications
fields.ai_hint: Each medication the patient reports, with dose and prescriber when stated. One item per medication.

fields.label: Substance Use History
fields.ai_hint: Alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, and other substance use as the patient describes it. Populate only when explicitly discussed.

fields.label: Family History
fields.ai_hint: Family history of mental-health or substance-use conditions as the patient reports it. Populate only when explicitly discussed.

fields.label: Developmental History
fields.ai_hint: Developmental milestones, early childhood, and educational history the patient describes. Populate only when discussed.

fields.label: Trauma History
fields.ai_hint: Traumatic experiences the patient discloses. Use the patient's own framing; do not infer trauma from absence. Often deferred from intake.

fields.label: Social History
fields.ai_hint: Housing, employment, education, finances, legal involvement, military service, and cultural or spiritual identity as discussed.

fields.label: Relationships & Supports
fields.ai_hint: Family system, partners, friends, and other support network as the patient describes them.

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Audible features only: rate, rhythm, volume, fluency. Do not infer; report what is heard.

fields.label: Mood & Affect
fields.ai_hint: Self-reported mood in quotes where possible; affect inferred from prosody and content (e.g. congruent, blunted, labile).

fields.label: Thought Process & Content
fields.ai_hint: Linear vs. tangential is audible. Suicidal or homicidal ideation, delusions, or obsessions only when the patient explicitly reports them.

fields.label: Perception
fields.ai_hint: Hallucinations, derealization, or depersonalization only when the patient explicitly reports them.

fields.label: Strengths
fields.ai_hint: Personal strengths, resources, and protective qualities the patient names or demonstrates. One item per strength.

fields.label: Initial Recommendations
fields.ai_hint: Recommended level of care, modality, frequency, and any referrals as discussed in session.

label: Medications
description: The client's current and past medications.

fields.label: Drug
fields.ai_hint: Medication names, current and past.

fields.label: Dose
fields.ai_hint: Dosage for each medication.

fields.label: Route
fields.ai_hint: Route of administration for each medication.

fields.label: Frequency
fields.ai_hint: How often each medication is taken.

fields.label: Prescriber
fields.ai_hint: Prescribing clinician for each medication.

fields.label: Start/Stop Dates
fields.ai_hint: Start date, and stop date if discontinued, for each medication.

fields.label: Notes
fields.ai_hint: Additional notes on efficacy, side effects, or adherence.

label: Meeting Summary
description: Professional minutes for a recorded business meeting — attendees, discussion, decisions, and action items. For calls that are not clinical sessions, e.g. vendors, referral partners, or consultants.

fields.label: Attendees
fields.ai_hint: People present in the meeting, with role or affiliation when stated in the transcript. Never invent names.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.ai_hint: Why the meeting happened — the stated objective or agenda, in one or two sentences.

fields.label: Summary
fields.ai_hint: A concise narrative of the discussion: the main topics, each party's position, and how the conversation concluded.

fields.label: Key Points
fields.ai_hint: The most important takeaways from the discussion.

fields.label: Decisions
fields.ai_hint: Decisions actually made in the meeting, each with who made or agreed to it. Exclude options merely discussed.

fields.label: Action Items
fields.ai_hint: Concrete commitments, each with its owner and due date when the transcript states them.

fields.label: Open Questions
fields.ai_hint: Questions raised but not resolved, or topics explicitly deferred to a later conversation.

fields.label: Next Meeting
fields.ai_hint: Agreed date, time, or cadence for the next touchpoint, if one was discussed.

label: Narrative
description: A single free-form narrative note for sessions that do not fit a structured format.

fields.label: Note
fields.ai_hint: A clinically-appropriate narrative summary of the session.

label: Psychotherapy note
description: Your own notes on a session, kept apart from the progress note.

label: Safety Plan
description: Stanley-Brown Safety Planning Intervention (Stanley & Brown 2012). Endorsed by VA/DoD CPG, SAMHSA, Zero Suicide Institute, and Joint Commission NPSG 15.01.01. Six strict steps — surveyors check the Step 3 (distractions) vs. Step 4 (help-seeking) distinction, and require means-restriction to be specific, not the word 'discussed.' Replaces the contraindicated 'no-suicide contract' (Rudd et al. 2006); do not add one. Transcript-mode rule applies: the LLM only populates a step's field when the recording explicitly supports it — warning signs and coping strategies must come from the patient, never invented from absence.

fields.label: Warning Signs
fields.ai_hint: Personal warning signs the patient identifies — thoughts, images, mood states, situations, or behaviors that signal a developing crisis. Use the patient's own language. One item per sign. Populate only when the patient names them.

fields.label: Internal Coping Strategies
fields.ai_hint: Things the patient can do alone — without contacting another person — to take their mind off the crisis (e.g. exercise, music, prayer, a specific routine). One strategy per item. Populate only what the patient names.

fields.label: People & Settings for Distraction
fields.ai_hint: People or social settings the patient can use as a distraction from suicidal thoughts. NOT for help-seeking — that is Step 4. Do not include phone numbers here; names of people or places only. Populate only what the patient names.

sections.label: Step 4 — People to Ask for Help

fields.label: People to Ask for Help
fields.ai_hint: People the patient will contact for help during a crisis — distinct from Step 3 distractions. Each item should capture the person's name and phone number as the patient gives them. Populate only what the patient names.

fields.label: Professional & Agency Contacts
fields.ai_hint: Clinicians, urgent-care lines, and crisis services the patient will contact. Each item should capture name, role, and phone number. The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline must be present; add it if the patient did not name it.

fields.label: Firearms Restriction Plan
fields.ai_hint: The specific plan for restricting access to firearms — who will store them, where, by when. Surveyors reject the word 'discussed'; the plan must be concrete. Populate only what the patient and clinician agreed to in the recording.

fields.label: Medications Restriction Plan
fields.ai_hint: The specific plan for securing medications — lockbox, supply limits, who holds the key. Concrete, not 'discussed.' Populate only what was explicitly agreed.

fields.label: Other Means Restriction Plan
fields.ai_hint: Any other lethal means addressed (sharps, ligatures, vehicles, location access) and the specific restriction plan. Populate only what was explicitly discussed.

fields.label: Reasons for Living
fields.ai_hint: Patient-named reasons for living (Linehan adjunct used by many SPI programs). One reason per item, in the patient's own framing. Populate only what the patient names.

label: SOAP
description: Subjective / Objective / Assessment / Plan — the default clinical format used for individual therapy sessions.

fields.label: Chief Complaint
fields.ai_hint: The primary reason the client stated for attending this session.

fields.label: Mood/Affect
fields.ai_hint: Client's self-reported mood and observed affective tone.

fields.label: Symptoms
fields.ai_hint: Discrete symptoms the client reported in this session.

fields.label: Client Narrative
fields.ai_hint: A concise narrative of what the client discussed.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.ai_hint: Observed physical presentation of the client.

fields.label: Behavior
fields.ai_hint: Observed behavioral patterns during the session.

fields.label: Speech
fields.ai_hint: Rate, rhythm, volume, and coherence of speech.

fields.label: Thought Process
fields.ai_hint: Organization and logic of the client's thinking.

fields.label: Affect Observed
fields.ai_hint: Clinician-observed affective presentation.

fields.label: Clinical Impression
fields.ai_hint: Clinician's overall impression of the client's current state.

fields.label: Progress
fields.ai_hint: Movement relative to treatment goals since the last session.

fields.label: Risk Assessment
fields.ai_hint: Any observed or reported risk to self or others.

fields.label: Functioning Level
fields.ai_hint: Client's current functional status.

fields.label: Interventions Used
fields.ai_hint: Therapeutic interventions applied during this session.

fields.label: Homework Assignments
fields.ai_hint: Tasks or practices assigned to the client between sessions.

fields.label: Next Steps
fields.ai_hint: Planned clinical focus for upcoming sessions.

fields.label: Next Session
fields.ai_hint: Scheduled date/time or cadence for the next appointment.

label: Treatment Plan
description: Written treatment plan, signed by clinician — required by CMS (42 CFR 410.43), state Medicaid plans, CARF 1.J., Joint Commission PC.01.03.01, and all major MCOs for continued authorization. Not separately billable, but a missing or stale plan voids reimbursement for the underlying therapy sessions. Drafted by cross-note synthesis from the patient's intake and recent session notes — not from a live transcript — then reviewed and signed between sessions. Goals must be measurable; objectives must be SMART and link back to a goal; interventions must link back to an objective; review_due_date is the single most common audit failure.

fields.label: Problem List
fields.ai_hint: Draft the patient's clinical problems from the intake note's presenting concern, history of present illness, and DSM-5 impressions. One concise problem per item, in clinical language the clinician will refine. Do not invent problems not supported by the source notes.

fields.label: Strengths & Supports
fields.ai_hint: Draft from the intake's strengths section and any supports the patient described (relationships, employment, recovery capital). One item per strength or support; mirror the patient's framing where it is in the source notes.

fields.label: Long-Term Goals
fields.ai_hint: Draft long-term goals from intake themes plus recent session progress. One goal per item; prefer the patient's own words where they appear in the source notes. Goals are aspirational outcomes — the clinician will decompose them into SMART objectives separately, so do not pre-write objectives here.
